_what_this_is: The device text every gate-harness needle hands the compiler, derived host-side by parity/meep_gpu/record_gate_needle_anchors.py: per table, the strings its legs rewrite and, per needle, its identity, whether it is borrowed from the probe's shared default, and per matched target the site count and the mutated text's sha256. Checked on every test run by test_mutation_anchors.py; re-mint with --write in the change that moves it.
